mapper.select: SELECT rt.id, rt.type, rt.percent FROM patient p JOIN reimburse_type rt ON p.reimburse_id = rt.id WHERE p.id = #{patientId}
SELECT tns.ori_cost FROM doc_schedule_record dsr JOIN doctor d ON dsr.doc_id = d.id JOIN title_number_source tns ON d.doc_title_id = tns.id WHERE dsr.id = #{scheduleRecordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_record (id, pay_time, pay_status, ori_amount, ask_pay_amount, patient_id, doc_id, sch_id) VALUES (#{payment.id}, #{payment.payTime}, #{payment.payStatus}, #{payment.oriAmount}, #{payment.askPayAmount}, #{payment.patientId}, #{payment.docId}, #{payment.schId})
mapper.select: SELECT pr.id AS "paymentId", pr.patient_id AS "patientId", pr.sch_id AS "scheduleRecordId", pr.doc_id AS "doctorId", u.name AS "doctorName", d.name AS "departmentName", pr.pay_time AS "payTime", pr.pay_status AS "payStatus", pr.ori_amount AS "oriAmount", pr.ask_pay_amount AS "askPayAmount", rt.percent AS "reimbursePercent", rt.type AS "reimburseType" FROM pay_record pr LEFT JOIN doctor doc ON pr.doc_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN "user" u ON doc.id = u.id LEFT JOIN department d ON doc.depart_id = d.id LEFT JOIN patient p ON pr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN reimburse_type rt ON p.reimburse_id = rt.id WHERE pr.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY pr.pay_time DESC

SELECT pr.id AS "paymentId", pr.patient_id AS "patientId", pr.sch_id AS "scheduleRecordId", pr.doc_id AS "doctorId", u.name AS "doctorName", d.name AS "departmentName", pr.pay_time AS "payTime", pr.pay_status AS "payStatus", pr.ori_amount AS "oriAmount", pr.ask_pay_amount AS "askPayAmount", rt.percent AS "reimbursePercent", rt.type AS "reimburseType" FROM pay_record pr LEFT JOIN doctor doc ON pr.doc_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN "user" u ON doc.id = u.id LEFT JOIN department d ON doc.depart_id = d.id LEFT JOIN patient p ON pr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN reimburse_type rt ON p.reimburse_id = rt.id WHERE pr.id = #{paymentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_record SET pay_status = #{status}, pay_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = '已支付' THEN NOW() ELSE pay_time END WHERE id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, pay_time AS "payTime", pay_status AS "payStatus", ori_amount AS "oriAmount", ask_pay_amount AS "askPayAmount", patient_id AS "patientId", doc_id AS "docId", sch_id AS "schId" FROM pay_record WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId}

SELECT #{patientId} AS "patientId", #{scheduleRecordId} AS "scheduleRecordId", tns.ori_cost AS "oriAmount", rt.type AS "reimburseType", rt.percent AS "reimbursePercent", mi.overage AS "medicalInsuranceOverage" FROM doc_schedule_record dsr JOIN doctor d ON dsr.doc_id = d.id JOIN title_number_source tns ON d.doc_title_id = tns.id LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.id = #{patientId} LEFT JOIN reimburse_type rt ON p.reimburse_id = rt.id LEFT JOIN medical_insurance mi ON p.medical_insuranceid = mi.id WHERE dsr.id = #{scheduleRecordId}

SELECT id, pay_time AS "payTime", pay_status AS "payStatus", patient_id AS "patientId", sch_id AS "schId" FROM pay_record WHERE pay_status = '待支付' AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time <= (NOW() - (#{timeoutMinutes} || ' minutes')::interval) ORDER BY pay_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_record SET pay_status = '已取消' WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND pay_status = '待支付'
